title: Model ownership and validation workflow
summary: A separated aircraft-acoustic predictor consumes source-bound receiver-relative vectors and produces predicted sound-arrival UTC and Doppler ratios. SPASH owns acoustic path hypotheses; Audio V9/Media Methodologies own captured STFT/ridges and PTS; Physics World owns advanced propagation and reflectors; Alchemy SQLite/RexxSQL owns indexes. Neither source equality nor a virtual-mic prediction creates independent evidence.
invariants: Use original media samples and their immutable source/method-clock provenance; converted audio and virtual microphones are derived, not independent observations.
Keep the known true receiver location private and withheld from blind localisation evaluation; never publish home coordinates or original media in git.
Source clock timezone and capture PTS must be resolved explicitly; 2023-10-10 Cyprus local civil time was UTC+3, but filename conventions must be verified.
Retarded time is emission UTC plus slant distance/sound speed; project full 3D aircraft motion relative to stationary microphone for Doppler.
Unknown emitted engine harmonics must be fitted, not fabricated; keep alternatives and independent withheld intervals.
procedure: Use existing 2023-10-10 Paphos read-only SQLite index, not a new 1.7GB ingest, where accessible.
Derive aircraft/receiver vectors with a documented Earth frame, height datum and velocity provenance.
Predict per-sample sound-arrival UTC and Doppler ratio; fit observed ridges with bounded clock/frequency nuisance terms.
Score multiple candidate aircraft and withheld windows; report coverage gaps as unknown, not as proof of absence.
